collection.title: MAXUS Deliver-9 2019 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A MAXUS Deliver-9 (2019 Onwards) requires windscreen wiper blades to ensure clear visibility in all weather conditions. The driver's side blade should be 26" in length, while the passenger's side blade should be 18". These windscreen wiper blades are specifically designed to fit the MAXUS Deliver-9 (2019 Onwards) model, which features a Hook type arm attachment for easy installation. Trust our high-quality windscreen wiper blades to maintain excellent visibility and keep you safe on the road.
